column1: Annika Sörenstam is a Swedish professional golfer.
She is the second highest-scoring female in history, in both European and American professional sports history.
She is the first to win the Ladies European Tour Money List Award, Women’s British Open, Ricoh Women’s British Open, and Women’s British Amateur.
She is the first golfer to win four major titles in a calendar year.
She also holds the title of the youngest woman ever to qualify for a major.
